description: Opt-in citation verification, separate from the guard. Resolves DOI, arXiv, and PMID identifiers found in the text against their public resolvers (doi.org, arxiv.org, NCBI E-utilities) and reports verified / not_found / unverifiable / unsupported per citation. Case citations and 'et al.' references are unsupported — no public resolver can check them. This tool makes network requests; aegis_check_output never does. An existing identifier is not a true claim — verification answers only 'does this identifier resolve?'.
name: aegis_verify_citations
